oral_examination.oral_examination: *34*36 Extensive caries on the distal and adjacent maxillofacial surfaces, with decay detected, sensitive probing, percussion (-), cold diagnosis ().

treatment_plan.definitive: After the root canal treatment of the tooth, the crown is restored. The patient is informed of the course of treatment, related risks and costs, and the patient agrees to the treatment.
treatment_plan.notes: Ask for follow-up consultation if you feel unwell. Bite a cotton roll for 40 minutes. Do not brush your teeth or rinse your mouth for 24 hours. You can eat and drink after 2 hours. It is recommended that the food should not be too hot.
